verdict.rationale: Skyfire says its tokens conform to the 'open KYAPay protocol', but the evidence names no independent party beyond Skyfire that implements it. The only other relevant material is marketing language such as 'accepted by the majority of the commercial internet' and card-network partnerships. Sellers listed on Skyfire's approval-gated directory are customers of the platform, not independent implementers, so the ecosystem claim is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration
